svg.title: iOS · Shape-mation · builder · projects · portrait
svg.desc: Mirrors App/Shapemation/ShapemationBuilderView.swift (ShapemationProjectsView + ShapemationProjectRow + ShapeOverlayThumbnail, the projects step of the shape-slideshow builder) over ShapemationBuilder. 2026-09-11, code first, mirrored from the running app; redrawn 2026-09-20 from the Debug build on the iPhone 16 Pro simulator over an APFS clone of the tram library (LL_SHAPEMATION=build LL_CHIPS=tram, then Next · shape → Rectangle → Next · projects → Pick all), the copy checked against the Mac Debug build's AX dump. Pushed from the Match step (back reads "Match") inside the Shape-mation sheet: large title "Rectangles" (the family's title, pluralised), then the count line "83 of 83 picked" (13 secondary) — SINCE 2026-09-20 the count is of the FILTERED set (Apply filters' lit tags and words), not the library — and a LazyVStack of white llCards (radius 14, spacing 10, padding 12), one per filtered project whose register holds at least one instance of the family that passes Match. Each row: the project's representative picture on the leading side, fitted into a 96×96 frame (the tram photos are 3:4 portraits, so 72×96) with every instance of the family traced over it — white at 85% (1.5 pt) when unpicked, the picked instance in amber (2.5 pt); then the title (15 semibold, one line), "1 rectangle · Photo" (12 secondary — instance count · capture mode) and "2 860 px · 95 % of the frame" (12 tertiary — the picked instance's native long side and its share of the photo's short edge); a Spacer; and the pick mark, checkmark.circle.fill (22, accent) when picked or circle (22, secondary at 50%) when not. Tapping anywhere on the row toggles it. INSTANCE PILLS — when a picked project holds SEVERAL instances of the family, the px line is replaced by a row of capsules, one per instance, "1 · 2 860 px", "2 · 1 120 px" … (11 medium, 8×4 padding, spacing 6; the chosen instance accent-filled with white text, the rest secondary at 15% with primary text); tapping one makes it the instance the slideshow locks on. One of the 83 tram projects holds two rectangles, but it is far down the list, so no pill is drawn here. SORT (design-first 2026-09-11, Steven, ON by default): a Menu on the count line's trailing side — "Sort Largest first ⌄" (the word Sort is the tinted Menu label — accent at ~55 % over the screen, measured (218,174,123) on the capture; "Largest first" full accent semibold) — Largest first (the DEFAULT) · Smallest first · Capture order (called "Newest first" until 2026-09-19); the key is the picked instance's share of its photo, and the rows and the playback follow it, largest share first (95 · 92 · 85 · 76 % here), which is what makes the movie read as a zoom. Bottom: a safeAreaInset bar over .regularMaterial (drawn flat, 92% opaque) — "Clear" when everything is picked, otherwise "Pick all" (17, accent, leading) and the "Next · mode" NavigationLink (15 semibold, borderedProminent in accent, radius ~10) to the Mode step; DISABLED until at least two projects are picked (near-white #F8F8F7 fill, #C6C6C8 label). DRAWN STATE: Pick all pressed — "83 of 83 picked", amber traces, accent check marks, "Clear", Next live. The unpicked state (builder.projects.unpicked capture, same day) is the same layout with "0 of 83 picked", white traces on the pictures, grey ring marks, "Pick all" and the greyed Next. The fifth card starts at y 740.7 and lies under the bar until the list scrolls; its copy is not visible in the capture, so it is drawn as a bare card. Sample data is the tram clone on 2026-09-20: Photo 13. 9. at 12:57 (2 860 px · 95 %), Photo 13. 9. at 12:49 (2 783 px · 92 %), Photo 13. 9. at 12:47 (2 569 px · 85 %), Photo 13. 9. at 12:49 (2 311 px · 76 %) — the pictures are flat placeholders in the app's tile style (a street scene with a tram face where the found rectangle is; the tram-face glyph is not the photo, the traced rectangle is where the register puts it). Measured from the 402×874-pt simulator capture and re-anchored to this 393×852 canvas: top-anchored content follows the 59-pt safe top (the capture's 62), the pick marks and Sort menu sit 9 pt further left, the bottom bar 22 pt higher; the sheet's top at safe-top + 10 (69).
